mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days without regime dependence.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS declines by >0.25pp over prior 3 months.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate falling below 3.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances where UNRATE < 3.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in consumer spending (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates robust aggregate demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns through stronger revenue expectations over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances where RSAFS and HOUST both increase by >0.5% MoM.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary tightening cycles (FEDFUNDS >2.5% for 3 consecutive months) increase cost of capital, depressing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS > 2.5% and rising for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in >60% of instances where FEDFUNDS >2.5% and rising for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index base 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, reducing corporate earnings growth expectations and triggering negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 100.

mechanism_narrative: Quarterly GDP growth exceeding 0.5% (GDPC1) signals sustained economic expansion, supporting corporate earnings growth and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in >60% of instances where GDPC1 increases by >0.5% QoQ.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent employment growth (PAYEMS >100k MoM) and unemployment decline (UNRATE < -0.1% MoM) indicate accelerating labor market strength, boosting consumer spending and positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in >60% of instances where PAYEMS increases by >100k and UNRATE decreases by >0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: Two consecutive months of industrial production below 100 (INDPRO) indicate persistent supply chain disruption, reducing corporate profit margins and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in >60% of instances where INDPRO < 100 for 2 consecutive months.
